Python with function docstring, verify docstring count

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language:   `python`,
		Docstrings: true,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`def greet(name):
    """Say hello to someone."""
    return f"Hello {name}"
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.TotalLines)
}
```
